ownerDirection: Four desk cubicles arranged as one central Severance-inspired pinwheel, using a muted green/teal/ivory office palette in a dark reading room.

referenceAdaptation.referenceLayout: Four-part central pinwheel workstation cluster with matching seats and a green-carpeted office field.
referenceAdaptation.gameAdaptation: An orthographic 4x4 room uses the clockwise four-arm pinwheel: NW arm west, NE arm north, SE arm east, SW arm south. Cubicle geometry is compact enough to preserve every wall segment for a possible door.
referenceAdaptation.notAReplica: This study records an original game layout inspired by the reference arrangement; it does not copy a production set plan or graphics.

furnitureScale.physicalFootprintPolicy: The collision footprints cover the selected artwork's measured opaque feet, pedestals and chair caster bases. Desktop, divider, monitor and chair-back projections remain visual depth bounds rather than movement blockers.
furnitureScale.seatedAnchorPolicy: For every cardinal pose, groundY minus seatContactY is the 45 px image-vertical rise (0.375 tile); facings never rotate that vertical relation.

permanentCentralAssembly.collision: solid bases below; one permanent interconnected cubicle cluster
